scope: Post-policy symbolic diagnosis on the two already registered fixture states and unchanged closed-cell grid. No new physical fixture, forward/model/feature calculation, parameter change or budget selection.
derivation: At every deterministic dyadic split, recurse into every closed child containing the fixed matched point; count one ideal certified rejection for every child not containing it. Every surviving box must reach terminal resolution. Root/internal/sibling/terminal requests all counted. This is an optimistic necessary minimum, not sufficient closure cost.
boundary_reason: The domain midpoint lies on each axis first bisection face, so all 16 closed orthants contain the matched point. A valid exclusion cannot discard any of those point-containing cells.
decision_effect: If the maximum is below this geometric minimum, do not select it or release development. Preserve prescribed maximum failure; no post-result cap increase.
